name: Span wall
description: Adds layout modes to the Wallpapers tab: Fill spans one wallpaper over the whole virtual desktop (cover and crop), Fit keeps it fully visible, Stretch distorts it to cover and Center draws it unscaled, next to Ambxst's per-screen crops. A layout dropdown sits right of the content filters. Per-screen wallpaper pins are kept and restored when you switch back.
author: EliasLd
permissions: Reads the Quickshell screen layout to compute the spanning geometry
Persists the layout mode through Ambxst's mod settings
